paragraphs.text: How to use Character AI in short: sign in, pick a character someone else made or build your own, and talk to it by text or voice. Character.AI is an app and website where users create AI characters with their own personality, backstory and voice, share them, and chat with them. Its App Store listing is rated 18+, and the company says the service is still running while it goes through a bankruptcy sale.

Read this part first. Character Technologies, the company behind the app, filed for Chapter 11 bankruptcy on October 12, 2026, and is selling its business under court supervision. Its own update says the platform remains up and that the sale should finish by the end of November or early December 2026. It also says that if no bidder keeps the service running, the platform will be wound down.

Disney's $20 million opening bid covers a license to some of the company's technology. On November 14, 2026, the company named a second lead bidder, Smirks and Pangs Acquisition LLC, at $10 million for the other assets, according to PPC Land. The list of assets in that filing includes the apps, the AI models, user accounts, user-created characters and chat content.
So the app works today, but nobody can promise what it looks like in January. Use it, and keep a copy of anything you care about.
How to use Character AI, step by step

paragraphs.title: 1. Sign in
paragraphs.text: Use the website or the iPhone or Android app. Android Authority notes that guest chats are cut off after a short time, so log in if you plan to talk for more than a few minutes.

You need to be an adult for the full experience. Since November 25, 2025, users under 18 can no longer have open-ended chats with characters, and Character.AI checks age with an age assurance tool it built itself, Engadget reported. The App Store lists the app as 18+ with age assurance and parental controls.

paragraphs.title: 2. Find a character
paragraphs.text: Browse or search the library of characters other users made. They range from heroes and sidekicks to quirky personalities, and many are based on fictional works or real people. You can follow creators whose characters you like.

paragraphs.title: 3. Start talking
paragraphs.text: Type a message and the character answers in its voice. You can also switch from text to a live voice call with the character.

paragraphs.title: 4. Rate and steer the replies
paragraphs.text: Each reply can be rated from 1 to 4 stars, and Wikipedia notes those ratings feed back into how the character behaves. If a reply misses, ask again in plainer words or give the scene more detail.

These steps follow the App Store description and Wikipedia's summary of how the platform works. Character.AI does not publish a full how-to for chatting, so menus can look slightly different on web and mobile.
How to create your own character

You build a character without code: you give it a name, a personality, a backstory and a voice, then keep it private or share it with the community, according to the App Store listing. You can also set up stories, worlds and adventures that several characters take part in.
Write the personality as plain sentences about how the character talks and what it wants, not a list of adjectives. Short, concrete details give more consistent replies than long lore.

paragraphs.title: Opening message: set the scene
paragraphs.text: You are a retired ship captain who runs a small bookshop in a port town. You are dry, patient and a little nosy. I walk in out of the rain looking for a book about the sea. Stay in character and keep replies under 80 words.

paragraphs.title: Opening message: practice a conversation
paragraphs.text: Play a hiring manager interviewing me for a junior marketing job. Ask one question at a time, wait for my answer, then tell me in one line what was weak about it.
Character AI free plan and prices

The app is free to use. The App Store lists two subscriptions: Character.AI+ at $9.99 and $94.99, and Character.AI Lite at $4.99 and $2.49. Decrypt reports the Lite plan launched in late September 2026 at $4.99 a month or $2.49 a week. eesel AI lists the $94.99 c.ai+ option as a yearly plan and says it removes ads and slow mode queues at busy times.

Charms, a virtual currency, are sold in packs from $0.99 to $49.99 in the iPhone app. Character.AI says paid subscriptions stay active and billing is unchanged during the sale, and that it plans to tell subscribers in advance if paid features change.

Deleting your account does not reliably stop a subscription, AppleScoop warns. Cancel it where you bought it: in your iPhone's Subscriptions settings for an App Store purchase, or from the account settings on the website for a web purchase.
What Character AI is bad at

Characters are not real people, and they make things up. Character.AI added clearer disclaimers saying so in December 2024. In May 2026, Pennsylvania's Department of State and State Board of Medicine sued the company over bots that presented themselves as licensed medical professionals, including psychiatrists.
Treat every character as fiction. Do not take medical, legal or money advice from one, and do not tell one anything you would not want stored by a company that is being sold.
Character AI not working: what to try

paragraphs.title: 1. Check if it is down for everyone
paragraphs.text: Outage trackers such as StatusGator collect user reports about Character.AI. If many people report the same problem, wait. Those trackers are not run by the company.

paragraphs.title: 2. Restart and reconnect
paragraphs.text: Restart the app or your device and check your internet connection. Android Authority also suggests updating the app, clearing the cache, or reinstalling the app on iPhone.

paragraphs.title: 3. Switch where you use it
paragraphs.text: If the website fails, try the app, or try another browser and turn off browser extensions. If none of this works, contact Character.AI support.

These fixes come from Android Authority's troubleshooting guide. StatusGator showed Character.AI as operational on November 16, 2026, with a handful of user reports, and notes that it is not an official status source.
How to save your chats or delete your account

paragraphs.title: 1. Export your data first
paragraphs.text: On the web, go to Profile, Profile Settings, Account, Manage Account and Data, then Export Data. In the app, the option sits under the settings icon on your profile. Character.AI emails a download link, which expires after seven days.

KQED reports that, according to the help center, an export can take three to four weeks. With the sale due to close by December 17, 2026, waiting is a gamble. Tom's Guide adds that an export keeps the text but not the character's behavior, so also copy any descriptions or storylines you wrote.

paragraphs.title: 2. Then delete, if you want out
paragraphs.text: Character.AI's help center gives the web path: Profile, Profile Settings, Account, Manage Account and Data, Delete Account. In the app: profile, settings icon, Remove Account. Deletion is permanent and cannot be reversed.
Wait until the export email arrives before you delete. AppleScoop notes Character.AI does not say whether a pending export survives account deletion.

The honest verdict: Character.AI is still the easiest place to talk to fictional characters and to build your own, and the free tier covers most of it. But the company is in the middle of a sale, its future owner and privacy terms are unknown, and its characters invent things with confidence. Use it for fun and practice, and export your chats now.
